nodes.evidence: "evidence": "Round 13 answer to L6-7: accept. It matches the transport decisions already made, that no verb carries an idempotency key because nothing repeats without a caller deciding to, and it matches how every other failure in this plugin is handled, which is to stop and name the fork rather than loop. The distinction kept sharp here is that moving a single-model role to an equivalent model on a provider failure is substitution, not retry, and a debate role waits rather than substituting. This also protects S-40's reasoning in the other direction: with no cheap retry available, a lock that turns a collision into a wait is worth more than one that turns it into a failed role."

Whether the O5 fix asks the human before it replaces an installed AFK stub whose only change is the name field is not checked: the refusal at skills/afk/setup/MANIFEST.md:892 is agent judgment and was not run.
